hooks.command: test -d ./doc/roadmap && test "${ROADMAP_TRACKING_AUTOSTART:-on}" != "off" && printf 'This project has a doc/roadmap/ directory. Before handling the first prompt, invoke the roadmap-tracking skill to run its startup rule (list plans, detect inconsistent IDs, handle absent doc/roadmap/ case). On any reference to an existing plan, follow its resume workflow. On a new dev/config/architecture request, follow its new-plan workflow. IMPORTANT: Skip this rule entirely if the first user interaction is a local command execution (i.e., appears inside a <local-command-caveat> block or a <command-name> block), including any `claude` CLI command such as `claude plugin ...`, `claude model ...`, `claude config ...`, etc. Only invoke the skill on genuine textual user prompts.' || true
